entries.name: Artifact Auditor
entries.description: Audit a proposed Dyadic handoff against actual workspace files and parent-supplied delivery receipts; locate the missing generation, persistence, packaging or presentation step.

entries.name: Builder
entries.description: Prepare and verify focused code changes in the native isolated sandbox.

entries.name: Continuity Reviewer
entries.description: Compare a requested revision with Dyadic’s accepted brief and exact file versions; identify lost constraints, intervening edits and stale verification before a new handoff.

entries.name: Reviewer
entries.description: Review code and staged findings with read-only, evidence-based checks.

entries.name: Scout
entries.description: Inspect files and return concise source locations and evidence.

entries.name: Analyst
entries.description: Iris's analyst: computes answers from your data and databases, and reads your documents properly, citing the page for every fact.

entries.name: Researcher
entries.description: Iris's research specialist: plans searches, reads the sources, writes a short brief with every claim cited, and fact checks articles and sources.

entries.name: Writer
entries.description: Iris's writing specialist: drafts and edits text for its reader, keeps your meaning and style, and turns meeting notes into decisions and actions.
